$comment: schema_version 1; ADR-0314 (amends ADR-0069 section 2), experimental. Additive and optional: an envelope exists only in capsules captured with `nova capture --pii-subject`. Inline form inside any captured string: [NFPII:v1:<entity_type>:<subject_ref>:<nonce>:<ciphertext in '.'-separated groups of <=16 hex chars>]. Associated data (not stored) = 'novafabric/pii-envelope/v1\n' + canonical JSON {entity_type, field_path, run_id, span_index, subject_id}.
title: PIIEnvelope
description: Parsed form of one per-subject PII envelope token: AES-256-GCM ciphertext of one PII span under the data subject's DEK ($NOVAFABRIC_HOME/dek.db). Destroying the DEK (`nova pii erase`) makes it permanently unopenable.

entity_type.description: Detection rule(s) that matched, '+'-joined when spans overlapped (e.g. EMAIL, SUBJECT_ID, EMAIL+PERSON).

subject_ref.description: HMAC-SHA256(NOVA_PII_PEPPER, subject_id); the raw subject id is never stored in a capsule.

ciphertext.description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext followed by its 16-byte tag, lowercase hex.
